description: This file defines the DirectoryMembershipService class, which manages and updates the view of cluster membership information within the Orleans runtime. It handles membership update events, maintains the current view, and provides mechanisms for refreshing and disseminating membership data.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipService
classes.description: Implements a service to track and update current cluster membership, providing asynchronous updates and refresh capabilities.

methods.name: RefreshViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the latest cluster membership view, optionally waiting for a specific version.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Background task that listens to membership updates and updates the current view accordingly.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the service, cancelling running tasks.

methods.name: LogErrorProcessingMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during membership update processing.
